identification: Three small tobacco/cigarette tins plus a round tin of mixed buttons and tokens. Left tin: WWI-era celluloid and tin patriotic badges (Wattle Day, hospital/appeal types) in colour. Centre: Red Cross and enamel badges, CDT Charcot, SA flag/union buttons. Right: Rising Sun-style hat badge, WWI Victory ribbon, brass buttons, medallions. Photo is a single overview, so individual badges cannot be rated. Mostly common charity tinnies and smalls.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline) for wattle day badge, rising sun hat badge, tin badges pins; work/comps.py for wattle, tin badges rising sun, badges militaria; one WebSearch for Tasmanian Wattle Day League badge (only museum records, no sold Tasmanian example found). eBay sold listings (Tasmanian Wattle Day, WWI tin badges) would help but are closed to us.
viewing_check: Open the left tin and check the Wattle Day badges for 'Tasmania' wording and any pennant or rare appeal badge (hospital, Gallipoli, Wattle League map). Check the Rising Sun badge is a genuine WWI/KC type with slide or lugs, and look for any silver or named medal and the Victory ribbon bar. Check the copper penny date. Otherwise it is common tinnies and buttons.
